taiwan_basis: Taiwan Tourism Administration 2024 summary reported per-day spend

taiwan_basis: Taiwan Tourism Administration 2024 summary reported per-trip spend
notes: Both are official visitor-spend/trip measures for Total visitors, but trip length, periods, and currencies differ.

taiwan_basis: Taiwan Tourism Administration 2024 summary average stay
notes: Both sources report average nights/stay for Total inbound visitors. Japan period is 2025; Taiwan period is 2024.

taiwan_basis: Taiwan 2024 hotel expenditure per day for Total visitors
notes: Japan category is Accommodation from JTA Annex 2. Taiwan category is hotel expenditure from the official summary PDF. Similar broad category, not observed hotel-night prices.

taiwan_basis: Taiwan 2024 food and drink outside hotels per day for Total visitors

taiwan_basis: Taiwan 2024 Shopping category per day for Total visitors
